name: Banshee's Chorus Slave
description: A necromancer binds multiple souls together, creating a chorus of banshees whose screams can shatter walls. To control them, he keeps their mortal remains in a state of perpetual orgasm through magical stimulation, the souls experiencing the sensations remotely. Their screams of pleasure-pain become weapons, their eternal climax turned into artillery.

name: Reanimated Doll Collection
description: A collector of life-sized dolls uses necromancy to bind souls to his porcelain figures. The souls feel the unyielding hardness of their ceramic bodies and the invasive placements of display. The collector poses them in elaborate dioramas of depravity, changing their arrangements weekly while the souls remain eternally conscious.

name: Soul-Infused Necrotic Dildo
description: A particularly cruel necromancer binds someone's soul to their own preserved pelvic bone, carved into a phallic shape. The soul experiences every use from inside the bone, feeling penetration from both sides simultaneously. The artifact becomes a prized item in certain circles, its sentience amplifying the pleasure of those who wield it.

name: Necromantic Body Swap Prison
description: A prison where criminals' souls are bound to each other's corpses after execution. They wake in wrong bodies, wrong ages, wrong conditions, forced to serve their sentences in unfamiliar flesh. The worst punishment is being bound to a body specifically modified for sexual service to guards and other inmates.

name: Celestial Brothel of Second Chances
description: A seemingly benevolent afterlife establishment offers souls a chance to 'earn' a better reincarnation through service. They're given beautiful new bodies and must please celestial beings or ascended souls. The service never ends - just as they near their goal, new requirements are added, trapping them in eternal service with false hope.

name: Afterlife Training Academy
description: A seemingly prestigious academy in the afterlife promises to prepare souls for higher reincarnations. The curriculum consists entirely of sexual servitude training - perfecting techniques, learning to derive pleasure from any act, and breaking down resistance. Graduates don't move on; they're placed in the academy's permanent staff to train new arrivals.

name: Afterlife Reality Show
description: In a realm that feeds on emotional energy, souls become contestants in an eternal reality show. They're given new bodies and placed in elaborate scenarios of bondage, competition, and sexual service. Across the multiverse, beings watch and vote on their fate, with 'popular' contestants receiving more humiliating challenges for entertainment.

name: Afterlife Talent Agency
description: A bureau that matches souls with 'roles' in the afterlife. Beautiful souls become courtesans for powerful beings. Creative souls design new forms of pleasure. Strong-willed souls become 'training partners' for those learning domination. The agency presents it as finding one's perfect place, but it's really eternal typecasting in sexual roles.

name: Cosmic Spa of Rebirth
description: A luxurious spa that promises to prepare souls for reincarnation through 'cleansing treatments.' The treatments involve extensive bodily modifications, sensitivity enhancements, and conditioning to enjoy service. Souls leave not reborn, but as perfectly conditioned attendants for the spa's celestial clients, believing they're awaiting rebirth that never comes.

name: Soul Marketplace
description: In a bazaar where fate is traded, souls become currency. A soul can be bought and installed into a pleasure doll, a living garment, or even a sensation-recording device. Wealthy beings collect interesting souls, displaying them in private galleries or using them for parties. The souls remain fully conscious in their new purposes.

name: Celestial Auction House
description: Souls are auctioned to the highest bidder for various purposes: personal servants, entertainment, breeding stock, or even raw material for magical items. The auctioneers highlight each soul's mortal experiences and potential uses. Wealthy beings from across realities bid, treating souls as collectibles or consumables.

name: Divine Punishment Harem
description: A petty god collects the souls of beautiful women who died, judging them 'too attractive for mortal men.' He places them in his celestial harem, where they're given perfect, ageless bodies but stripped of free will. They exist only to please him and his guests, their souls forever trapped in blissful servitude they didn't choose.

name: Skeleton Slave
description: A necromancer captures a deceased person's soul and binds it to their own skeleton, stripped of flesh but magically preserved. The person is forced to serve as a mindless undead servant.

name: Succubus Transformation
description: Instead of passing on, a person's soul is captured by demons and transformed into a succubus. The person retains their memories and personality but now has an irresistible need to feed on sexual energy. The person is assigned to corrupt mortals, seducing them and feeding until they're drained husks. The worst part? The person learns to enjoy it, their former morals eroded by demonic hunger and pleasure.
